title: Exploring the role of pyroptosis and immune infiltration in sepsis based on bioinformatic analysis.
authors: Li, Zhi-Hua; Wang, Yi; Yu, Xiang-You
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于生物信息学分析脓毒症中焦亡与免疫浸润，仅涉及转录因子预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Sepsis is a disease that is typically treated in intensive care units with high mortality and morbidity. Pyroptosis is a newly identified type of programmed cell death and is characterized by inflammatory cytokine secretion. However, the role of pyroptosis in sepsis remains unclear. METHODS: GSE28750 and GSE134347 datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Differentially expressed pyroptosis genes (DEPGs) were identified between sepsis and healthy controls. Machine learning was used to further narrow the gene range. Receiver operating curves (ROC) were generated to estimate the diagnostic efficacy. Immune infiltration levels were estimated via single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA). A network database was used to predict the upstream transcription factors and miRNAs of DEPGs. Finally, the expression of the genes was validated by qRT-PCR between sepsis patients and healthy controls. RESULTS: We found that the pyroptosis pathway was enriched and activated in sepsis. 8 DEPGs were identified. A heatmap showed that the genes, NLRC4, NAIP, IL-18, AIM2 and ELANE, were abundant in the sepsis samples, and the genes, NLRP1, CHMP7 and TP53, were abundant in the healthy control samples. The ssGSEA results showed that the abundances of activated dendritic cells, MDSC, macrophage, plasmacytoid dendritic cells, regulatory T-cells, and Th17-cells were significantly higher, while the activated B-cell, activated CD8 T-cell, CD56 dim tural killer cell, immature B-cell, monocyte, and T follicular helper cell abundances were lower in sepsis samples compared to healthy controls. The qRT-PCR results showed that the expression levels of NAIP, IL-18, TP53, CHMP7, NLRC4, ELANE and NLRP1 were consistant with the bioinformatic analyses, while the expression level of AIM2 has no significant difference. CONCLUSION: Our study identified seven potential pyroptosis-related genes, NAIP, IL-18, TP53, CHMP7, NLRC4, ELANE and NLRP1. This study revealed that pyroptosis may promote sepsis development by activating the immune response.
abstract_zh: 目的：脓毒症是一种通常在重症监护室治疗的疾病，具有高死亡率和高发病率。焦亡（pyroptosis）是一种新发现的程序性细胞死亡类型，其特征是炎性细胞因子分泌。然而，焦亡在脓毒症中的作用仍不清楚。方法：从基因表达综合（GEO）数据库获取GSE28750和GSE134347数据集。在脓毒症与健康对照之间鉴定差异表达的焦亡基因（DEPGs）。使用机器学习进一步缩小基因范围。生成受试者工作特征曲线（ROC）以评估诊断效能。通过单样本基因集富集分析（ssGSEA）估计免疫浸润水平。使用网络数据库预测DEPGs的上游转录因子和miRNAs。最后，通过qRT-PCR在脓毒症患者和健康对照之间验证基因表达。结果：我们发现焦亡通路在脓毒症中富集并激活。鉴定出8个DEPGs。热图显示，基因NLRC4、NAIP、IL-18、AIM2和ELANE在脓毒症样本中丰富，而基因NLRP1、CHMP7和TP53在健康对照样本中丰富。ssGSEA结果显示，与健康对照相比，脓毒症样本中活化树突状细胞、MDSC、巨噬细胞、浆细胞样树突状细胞、调节性T细胞和Th17细胞的丰度显著更高，而活化B细胞、活化CD8 T细胞、CD56 dim自然杀伤细胞、未成熟B细胞、单核细胞和滤泡辅助T细胞的丰度较低。qRT-PCR结果显示，NAIP、IL-18、TP53、CHMP7、NLRC4、ELANE和NLRP1的表达水平与生物信息学分析一致，而AIM2的表达水平无显著差异。结论：我们的研究鉴定了七个潜在的焦亡相关基因，即NAIP、IL-18、TP53、CHMP7、NLRC4、ELANE和NLRP1。本研究揭示焦亡可能通过激活免疫反应促进脓毒症发展。
